description: The SDM MetricTile is two visuals in one: a fully customizable KPI tile, and a two-position filter button that drives the report page it sits on. As a KPI tile — build visually rich, high-impact dashboards with a data-driven tile component. Perfect for executive dashboards, summary cards and key performance indicators. 17 predefined shapes: rectangle, circle, ellipse, diamond, triangle, pentagon, hexagon, octagon, star (5 or 6 points), arrow, chevron, parallelogram, trapezoid, cross, heart, pill Independently customizable corners (right-angled, rounded, inward, rounded inward), gradients in 4 directions and adjustable transparency Free rotation, horizontal and vertical mirroring Visual effects: configurable drop shadows, glow halo, edge softening Data-driven fill colour and an embedded logo from a base64 image measure Manual positioning of label, value and logo in percentages, each formatted independently, with configurable display units and decimals As a filter button — switch Button Mode on and the tile becomes a two-position button. A click flips a persisted On/Off status, and each position applies its own filter to the page through the Power BI filter API — a country switch, a "my segment only" toggle, a branded image button. One filter per position: basic (list of values), advanced (conditions combined with And/Or) or tuple (several columns at once), written as JSON or…
